NewLook does not process any payments on behalf of professionals or customers. * **Cancellation Policy:** Customers wishing to cancel a booking must contact the concerned professional directly as soon as possible. تلتزم منصة نيولوك (NewLook) بحماية خصوصي: NewLook platform (NewLook) is committed to protecting the privacy of its users in Morocco. This policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your personal information when you use our platform, whether you are a registered professional or a customer. ## Information We Collect We collect different types of information to provide and improve our services: * **Identity and Contact Information:** When you register as a professional or book an appointment as a customer, we collect your name, phone number, and email address. For professionals, we also collect information about their city. * **Booking Information:** We collect details of bookings made through the platform, including the services booked and the date and time of the booking. * **Work Photos:** Professionals upload photos of their work to display in their profiles. * **Payment Receipts:** Professionals upload photos of bank transfer receipts for their subscriptions. * **Account Information:** When you create an account via email or Google, we collect the data necessary to create and manage your account. ## How We Use Your Information We use the information we collect for the following purposes: * **Providing Services:** To manage bookings, display professional profiles, and facilitate communication between customers and professionals. * **Managing Subscriptions:** To process and confirm professional subscriptions. * **Improving the Platform:** To analyze how users use our platform and improve their experience. * **Communication:** To send booking confirmations, reminders, or updates related to your account or our services. ## Information Sharing We do not sell your personal information to third parties. We may share your information in the following cases: * **With Professionals/Customers:** When you book an appointment, we share your name and phone number with the relevant professional to enable them to provide the service. Similarly, professional information is displayed to customers. * **For Legal Compliance:** We may disclose your information if required by Moroccan law, including compliance with Law 09-08 concerning the protection of individuals with regard to the processing of personal data. ## Protection of Your Data We take security measures to protect your personal information from unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction. However, no data transmission over the Internet can be guaranteed to be 100% secure. ## Your Rights According to Moroccan Law 09-08, you have the following rights regarding your personal data: * **Right of Access:** You can request access to your personal data that we hold. * **Right of Correction:** You can request correction of any inaccurate or incomplete personal data. * **Right of Objection:** You can object to the processing of your personal data in certain circumstances. To exercise these rights, please contact us through the contact form on the platform. We will process your request in accordance with the laws and regulations in force in Morocco, including the oversight of the National Commission for the Monitoring of Personal Data Protection (CNDP).
